title: MemoryImportsDiscardResponse
description: Success returns a MemoryReceipt (§6.10) whose result is a content-free summary: { "import_id": string, "discarded": true }. Errors use the shared ErrorEnvelope (§14.1) with details.retry_class (§14.2). Codes documented for memory.imports.discard (§7.33): IMPORT_CONFLICT, NOT_FOUND, NOT_AUTHORIZED. Dispatch-layer codes op_unsupported / capability_missing apply at the Connect boundary.
